verdict.rationale: A relay or edge proxy is a fair capability for a feature-flag SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hostable relay, forward proxy, or edge service that keeps SDK traffic inside the customer's network. SDK-side local caching and in-memory evaluation are adjacent resilience features, not a relay proxy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network
